input: Shop for a new winter coat on sale

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing who the coat is for (the user themselves, a child, a partner, etc.) determines the size range, style options, and priorities like warmth vs. fashion.
A hard budget ceiling narrows which sales and retailers to target, and defines what counts as a good deal.
Winter coats vary enormously — puffer, wool, parka, trench — and the right type depends on intended use (commuting, outdoor activities, formal wear), which changes the whole search.
How cold it gets and where the coat will be worn (urban commute vs. hiking vs. skiing) determines the required warmth rating, weatherproofing, and length.
Whether the user prefers shopping online, in-store, or both narrows down which retailers and sales channels to focus on.
Preferences like colour, hood, length, or specific features (waterproofing, packability) directly filter the options and prevent wasted time browsing irrelevant coats.

keyUnknowns.axis: success criteria / what done well looks like
keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Understanding whether the priority is the deepest discount, a specific brand, long-term durability, or speed of purchase determines how to evaluate options and when to stop searching.

questions.title: Who is this winter coat being bought for?
questions.description: Determine whether the coat is for the user, a child, or someone else, to establish size range and relevant style priorities.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for the coat?
questions.description: Establish a hard spending ceiling to target the right sales, retailers, and price brackets.

questions.title: What style or type of coat are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants a puffer, parka, wool coat, trench, or another style to focus the search appropriately.

questions.title: How cold is your climate and how will you mainly wear it?
questions.description: Understand the temperature range and primary use case — daily commuting, outdoor activities, formal occasions — to determine warmth and weatherproofing requirements.

questions.title: Do you prefer shopping online, in-store, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred shopping channel to focus on the right retailers, sale events, and availability options.

questions.title: Are there specific colours, features, or details you want?
questions.description: Capture style preferences such as colour, hood, length, waterproofing, or packability to filter options efficiently.

questions.title: What matters most — deepest discount, durability, or a specific brand?
questions.description: Define the primary success criterion so the user knows when they have found the right coat and can stop searching.
